svg.title: Video producer: live vs retired
svg.desc: Live: job API, progress, settings, download, captions, quality metrics, overview, poster and slide, scene feedback. Not built: YouTube upload (501). Removed by ADR-0953: Blender, Three.js and Manim tiers, screenshot capture, asset analysis.
